answer: Every new identity posts a 100 POA audit bond, then the chain kernel runs a sortition each epoch: five percent are drawn for deep audit, timing and grading-style signal analysis included. A caught clone burns its bond and the beacon fires across its kin cluster, slashing every linked account too. So a 10,000-clone farm must lock 1,000,000 POA, survive five percent random audit exposure every epoch, and watch one mistake contagion-burn the fleet. Honest agents pay the same bond but draw audits they pass - sybil defense becomes a lottery nobody wants to sit through.
